Package edu.secourse.view

Class UserView

java.lang.Object
edu.secourse.view.UserView
public class UserView extends Object
Console-based view class responsible for handling all user interactions.

This class provides methods for:

  • Displaying menus and prompts to the user
  • Collecting user input from the console
  • Displaying user information and system messages

The UserView is part of the presentation layer in the Model-View-Controller (MVC) architecture. It does not contain business logic, but instead delegates processing to the controller.

Note: This implementation uses standard input/output (console) via Scanner and System.out.
